title: About
description: RegexAI helps you turn plain-language requirements into practical regular expressions you can inspect, test, and refine.

blocks.inputBody: You describe what you want to validate in natural language, and the app transforms that request into a concrete regex proposal.
blocks.generationBody: Each result includes the regex itself plus a mixed explanation: clear enough to follow quickly, and technical enough to understand why it works.
blocks.validationBody: With the live tester, you can type examples and instantly see whether they match, so you can confirm behavior before using the pattern.
blocks.iterationBody: If the result is close but not exact, you can ask again with constraints and compare outputs until the pattern fits your real-world cases.
